from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path('/workspace/android-studio-parallel-sync-policy')
ARTIFACTS = Path('/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/parallel-sync-integration/app-build')
COMMIT = os.environ['KODA_LINK_COMMIT']
assert len(COMMIT) == 40 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in COMMIT)
PATHS = ['.', ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/*.md',
         ':(exclude)docs/android-studio/reference-manifest.json',
         ':(exclude)docs/android-studio/test-parity.json',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/ports/*.json',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/evidence/**/*.log',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/evidence/**/*.json']

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)

def digest(path):
    with (ROOT / path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def guard():
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == COMMIT
    for cached in [False, True]:
        args = ['diff', '--quiet'] + (['--cached'] if cached else [])
        subprocess.run(['git', *args, COMMIT, '--', *PATHS], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    assert not git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', *PATHS)

guard()
files = [p.decode() for p in git('ls-files', '-z', '--', *PATHS).split(b'\0') if p]
bindings = [{'path': p, 'sha256': digest(p)} for p in files if (ROOT / p).is_file()]
snapshot = {'tested_commit': COMMIT, 'git_tree': git('rev-parse', COMMIT + '^{tree}').decode().strip(),
            'scope': 'Whole source, dependencies and fixtures; unchanged fixed parity metadata exclusions.',
            'files': bindings}
(ARTIFACTS / 'whole-product-source-snapshot.json').write_text(json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2) + '\n')
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ARTIFACTS / 'retry-app-build.py')], cwd=ROOT)
guard()
for binding in bindings:
    assert digest(binding['path']) == binding['sha256'], binding['path']
(ARTIFACTS / 'whole-product-guard-result.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'tested_commit': COMMIT, 'child_exit_code': result.returncode,
    'whole_product_git_index_worktree_untracked_and_all_file_hash_guards_passed': True,
    'tracked_source_and_fixture_files': len(bindings)
}, indent=2) + '\n')
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
